name: Survival Horror
description: The survival kit stripped of comfort and pointed at dread: explore hostile space, ration an inventory that can never hold enough, evade a pursuer that announces itself just late enough, and spend save tokens like they are ammunition. Reuses VitalStats and SpoilageSystem from Survival Adventure but removes the building answers — housing is replaced by world.hiding_spot, warmth by light, and safety by the decision of when to save.
loop: explore dread space → ration scarce resources → evade/fight → survive setpiece

signatureCompound.name: Evade the Stalker
signatureCompound.description: A pursuit through a dark wing: the stalker converges on noise and sight, the player breaks line of sight into a hiding spot while the fear meter punishes both being seen and hiding too long, and the whole sequence sits between two token-gated saves. Proves that dread, scarcity, and pursuit reinforce rather than stack.
